subject.title: feat(ui): interleaved sidebar zone with custom session icons and drag ordering

question: Should OpenClaw accept this persisted, agent-writable SVG icon contract together with the reported 0.5 KiB startup-CSS increase beyond the currently exhausted budget?
rationale: The patch introduces a durable gateway/session API and an `unsafeHTML` rendering boundary while also requiring a product-performance tradeoff; neither choice is safely inferable from test success alone.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped contract
options.body: Approve the sanitized SVG and persisted `sessions.patch.icon` contract after owner review, provided the CSS delta is reduced to budget or the budget exception is explicitly accepted.

options.title: Narrow the icon format
options.body: Keep named icons and emoji but defer agent-authored SVG until maintainers choose and document the permanent security contract.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the whole sidebar-zone change until there is owner capacity to decide the API and performance direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped contract
recommendation.body: Approve the sanitized SVG and persisted `sessions.patch.icon` contract after owner review, provided the CSS delta is reduced to budget or the budget exception is explicitly accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current proposal and its documented security, synchronization, and performance tradeoffs.
